result.topic_en: Draft notes on Riemann's 1859 theory of finite-amplitude air waves: how, in the regions where the Riemann invariants (written as $\alpha\log\varrho \pm w$) are constant, values move with velocity $a\pm u$; how the width of a rarefaction (dilatation) wave grows and that of a compression wave shrinks in proportion to time; and the case of initial data constant outside an interval.
